flags.headline: EIX wildfire-liability/credit-downgrade risk gains a hard catalyst date: CA legislature's Aug 31 deadline
flags.detail: EIX closed Friday 7/31 at $73.41 (-6.76%), still unchanged as of this pre-market pull. Barclays cut EIX to Equal Weight (from Overweight), PT to $75 from $78, citing this regulatory uncertainty. The credit-downgrade warning is that risk moving from hypothetical to a dated (8/31) legislative catalyst.
